string.text: Really? Well, the Zone's making us happy, so it worked anyway. Hell, I can already imagine the government fuming when we publish everything. Great job, sis. You deserve a medal, and this.

That brave man helped us immensely several years ago. He managed to deactivate the Miracle Machine on his own, so that we were no longer threatened by its psychic emanations. He even worked as our Chief Scientist Consultant for some time, but sadly that was not to last. Regardless, Strelok was to the centre of the Zone. I shudder to imagine the things he witnessed and experienced in there. He must possess great knowledge about the inner workings of the Zone, perhaps its true origin as well. Young lady, do you know what that would mean for the scientific community?
You're a funny girl. Very funny. But I'm sworn off pot until I finish my mission. I'm not gonna budge.
